key_concepts: Earth rotates on its axis from west to east, completing one rotation in 24 hours
Earth's rotation causes day and night
The Sun appears to rise in the east and set in the west because Earth rotates west to east
Earth revolves around the Sun in a counterclockwise direction
Earth's orbit is elliptical, with perihelion as the closest point and aphelion as the fart
A leap year occurs every four years because the 1/4 day adds up to one extra day
Earth's axis is tilted at 23.5 degrees and points toward the North Star
The tilt of Earth's axis causes unequal lengths of daytime and nighttime
